{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a cleaned version of the data by replacing -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
trial_df_clean = trial_df.copy()
trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute the change in biomarker (final - baseline)
# Only compute for non-missing baseline values
trial_df_clean['biomarker_change'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_final'] - trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Check if arms are comparable in terms of baseline severity
severity_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Check if arms are comparable in terms of age
age_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['age'].mean()

# Check if arms are comparable in terms of sex
sex_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'sex']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

print('Severity distribution by arm:\n', severity_by_arm)
print('\nAge by arm:\n', age_by_arm)
print('\nSex distribution by arm:\n', sex_by_arm)"}
